verdict_rationale: Stage 3 WP-01 successfully enforces runtime fail-closed authority gates across all 6 engineering domains, eliminates textual backdoors, and isolates test helpers. However, public static method `sealBinding()` permits self-sealing by production callers without key authentication (IFA-DEFECT-001). Qualification is accepted under Stage 3 declared scope subject to explicit residual risk recording and remediation prior to Stage 4.

findings.title: Textual Backdoor Elimination Confirmed
findings.details: Automated scanning and `NoBackdoor.test.ts` confirm 0 occurrences of literal `MD-SEAL` or `TEST-SEAL` strings in production code, and 0 production imports of `mintCompromisedEnvelope` or `__test_helpers__`.

findings.title: Public Static Sealing Vulnerability Identified (IFA-DEFECT-001)
findings.details: `CanonicalDomainBindingEngine.sealBinding()` is a public static method accessible to any caller. While execution token structure requires geometry and revision parameters, any caller can mint a valid-looking seal without presenting a private boot key.

findings.title: Direct Solver Fail-Closed Rejection Confirmed
findings.details: All 31 test files (~167 individual tests) that attempt direct solver invocation without an authoritative binding are rejected with `SIMULATION_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION`. This confirms that runtime solvers independently enforce authority gates.

findings.title: Pre-Existing Baseline Failures Reconstructed and Isolated
findings.details: All 36 failing test files (~109 individual tests) outside authority rejection were confirmed to be pre-existing CFD boundary vector, CAD surface loft, or UI mock issues present prior to WP-01.

findings.title: Reconstructed Source Files Validated
findings.details: `SpatialMaterialField.ts` public interface was verified and confirmed to have 6 active production call sites. `package.json` dependencies were reconciled with `package-lock.json`.

residual_risks.description: Production callers can construct and self-seal CanonicalDomainBinding instances directly until key-authenticated sealing is enforced in `CanonicalDomainBindingEngine.ts`.

scope_guardrails_for_stage_4: 1. WP-02 must enforce caller key authentication in `sealBinding()` during boot initialization.
2. Do not modify solver mathematics or physics models.
3. Do not loosen authority assertion in existing tests.
4. Preserve all 7 IFA evidence artifacts as permanent audit records.
